subject: Any way to specify offset for first label on date scale ?

messages.author: 92a46c9449c605e2
messages.subject: Any way to specify offset for first label on date scale ?
parts:
Hello,

Does anyone know a way to use scale_x_date with a specification of the
x value at which to begin the labeling?

I'm using the code below, which places the first x label at the first
value of x ... and subsequent labels every 3 months. I need the first
label to appear at the second value of x (which corresponds to the
second 'month' of data ... "March" which is a more intuitive place to
start quarterly labels).

scale_x_date(major="3 months", format="%b \n%Y")

Thanks much for any insight on this,
Mauricio
